item.title: What is the difference between phone brightness and screen quality?
item.description: Phone brightness and screen quality aren't the same thing. Brightness measures light output in nits, determining outdoor visibility, while screen quality encompasses resolution, color accuracy, contrast ratio, and display technology. You can have a blindingly bright screen with poor quality, or a stunning display with moderate brightness.
